bundle.shortDescription: Privacy-preserving PDF editor from FACTS-H Lab
bundle.longDescription: View, organise, annotate, redact, OCR and sign PDFs entirely on your own machine. No document ever leaves the device. Built by FACTS-H Lab at the Indian Institute of Information Technology, Kottayam.
